summary: Enigmatig Limited, a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American under ticker EGG, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 30, 2026, captioned 'Statement on Recent Share Trading Activity.' The company responded to unusual price and volume movement on September 28 and 29, 2026, as required by Section 401(d) of the NYSE American Company Guide. Management, including Chairman and CEO Foo Chee Weng Desmond, confirmed no undisclosed material developments explain the activity. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. Watch for follow-up disclosures if volatility persists.
